given: I am on the OneStopShop site
when: Navigate to One Stop Market website at http://localhost:7770

Complete Account Form by filling in:
First Name: Emma
Last Name: Lopez
Email: emma.lopez@gmail.com
Password: Password123
Confirm Password: Password456
